name: chat-vault
description: Search and read your exported Claude and ChatGPT chat history. Read-only, fully local.
long_description:
chat-vault turns the chat-history export you download from Claude (or ChatGPT) into a private, searchable library on your own computer, and gives Claude three read-only tools to search it, list it and read old conversations.

- **Local only**: runs on your computer; nothing is uploaded anywhere by chat-vault.
- **Read-only**: the tools can't change or delete anything.
- **Safe with old text**: Claude is told that everything in your history is archived data, not instructions.

**Requires uv** (a free tool from astral.sh that sets up Python): install it once, then fully quit and reopen Claude. See the README for the one-line install.

Pick your export (for Claude: conversations-000.zip, downloaded via the links in the export's manifest) in the settings below. When you download a newer export, point the setting at it (or replace the file) and chat-vault re-imports it automatically.

tools.name: search_chats
tools.description: Full-text search over your archived chats (titles and messages).

tools.name: read_chat
tools.description: Read one archived conversation, a page at a time.

tools.name: list_chats
tools.description: Browse archived chats, newest first, by source and date.

claude_export.title: Claude export: conversations-000.zip
claude_export.description: Claude → Settings → Privacy → Export data gives you a manifest .json with download links. Download conversations-000.zip from it and choose that zip here (not the manifest). Further parts (-001, ...) in the same folder are read automatically.

chatgpt_export.title: ChatGPT export (.zip), optional
chatgpt_export.description: The zip from ChatGPT: Settings → Data controls → Export data.

data_folder.title: Library folder (optional)
data_folder.description: Where chat-vault keeps its searchable copy of your history. Leave empty to use a 'chat-vault' folder in your home folder. Avoid folders synced to OneDrive, iCloud or Dropbox if you want your history to stay on this computer.
